scope: Selected rules only; three grade tracks and three authored challenges each.

entries.skill: Produce reviewed singular/plural noun phrases and a/an according to the following sound.
entries.evidenceRule: Explicit determiner or numeral in an accepted causal phrase, without shown solutions or corrections.
assistanceConditions: shown spelling suggestion or order model
tests: article follows the next spoken sound in the supported vocabulary
singular and plural count agreement creates actual quantities

entries.skill: Retrieve and spell the small contextual object vocabulary, revise after consequences.
entries.evidenceRule: Typed accepted noun in an object contributing to the solution; dictionary and shown spelling suggestion or order models are assisted.
assistanceConditions: shown spelling suggestion or order model
tests: near-spelling is proposed, never silently accepted as unaided spelling
transfer ferry permits a boat or physically long alternate bridge

entries.skill: Interpret longer than and heavier than against actual measured quantities.
entries.evidenceRule: Successful span end support or strict mass comparison, then physical traversal. No comparative-form production claim.
assistanceConditions: shown spelling suggestion or order model
tests: same-looking crossing with longer gap changes valid property action
strict heavier-than boundary respects the comparison reference

entries.skill: Identify one of two matching crates from persistent actor/location history.
entries.evidenceRule: Medicine crate itself exceeds reference mass and occupies the pressure plate; garden crate cannot substitute.
assistanceConditions: shown spelling suggestion or order model
tests: history changes the valid crate while preserving identical visible noun
unrelated weight cannot substitute for making the identified medicine crate heavier

entries.skill: Choose physical descriptors according to the stated need.
entries.evidenceRule: Selected property changes length/mass and resulting available route.
assistanceConditions: shown spelling suggestion or order model
tests: weight comparative uses real mass rather than size or noun password

entries.skill: Combine size and material in reviewed noun phrases.
entries.evidenceRule: At least two distinct modifier categories in the taught order on a causal object, without assistance. Alternatives still win without falsely earning this evidence.
assistanceConditions: shown spelling suggestion or order model
tests: size and material independently change cargo capacity/floatability
order production needs two modifiers, not a vacuous one-word check

entries.skill: Distinguish a named known fan from a fan identified by actor/location.
entries.evidenceRule: Fan A identity remains stable despite shared additional information; tree fan selected for defining description. No independent score for non-defining-clause comprehension or clause production.
assistanceConditions: shown spelling suggestion or order model
tests: Fan A is the known referent even when both fans match additional information
G9 transfer combines cargo and identified force with multiple valid containers

entries.skill: Use powerful/powerless as reviewed members of the power family.
entries.evidenceRule: Typed family adjective on the identified causal fan; 12 N versus 0 N and actual sail movement.
assistanceConditions: shown spelling suggestion or order model
tests: power is distinguished from powerful/powerless with observable force
fan force needs correct direction as well as word family choice

entries.skill: Choose size/material/force descriptors for cargo and sail constraints.
entries.evidenceRule: Both capacity/buoyancy and identified directional force constraints satisfied in changed context.
assistanceConditions: shown spelling suggestion or order model
tests: G9 transfer combines cargo and identified force with multiple valid containers

excluded: All chapter-10 tense coverage; complementary games own it
broad vocabulary acquisition from twelve nouns

verification.campaign: All nine actual UI paths completed, including mistakes/recovery and all three transfer routes; see individual state JSON/captures.
verification.limitations: Automated functional evidence only; see PLAYTEST.md for controls and audio/browser limitations.
verification.finalRegression: docs/playable-loop/regression.mjs passed fullscreen exit, nested Escape, replay variation and accurate two-component unaided reporting with zero page errors.
verification.mobileEvidence: docs/qa-captures/mobile-summary.json — all touch and assistance assertions passed
